entity.summary: Open-source self-custodial multichain wallet formerly branded MyTonWallet, now distributed as My Wallet across mobile, browser-extension and desktop surfaces.
entity.notes: Current first-party site explicitly states that My Wallet was formerly known as MyTonWallet. WLR preserves one continuous entity lineage rather than treating the rebrand as a new wallet launch. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current self-custodial My Wallet mobile application, preserving the former MyTonWallet product lineage.
products.notes: Selected mobile runtime only. Browser extension, desktop and Telegram mini-app surfaces are deferred. Rebrand does not reset launch chronology.

evidence.title: My Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site describes My Wallet as fully self-custodial and explicitly states that it was formerly known as MyTonWallet.

evidence.title: Install My Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution surface for the renamed My Wallet product family; mobile is selected for this breadth pass while other runtimes are deferred.
